sources.title: Running Qwen 3.5 Locally on a Single GPU: Complete Setup Guide
sources.snippet: Conclusion Running Qwen 3.5 locally is a powerful way to access a massive language model while keeping everything private and completely under your control. In this guide, the model was hosted on a single H200 GPU VM, accessed securely from your local machine using SSH port forwarding, and served through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (llama.cpp).
